items.actClause:
AN ACT in relation to authorizing the town of Smithtown, county of Suffolk, to
alienate and convey certain parcels of land used as parklands
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S6973

SPONSOR: FLANAGAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act in relation to authorizing the town of Smithtown, county of
Suffolk, to alienate and convey certain parcels of land used as park-
lands

 
PURPOSE:

Section 1 authorizes the town of Smithtown, to alienate and convey 4,000
square feet of land, and to transfer said parcel to the County of
Suffolk for the purpose of placing and operating a sewer pump station at
the Town of Smithtown Department of Parks, Buildings and Grounds located
at 100 Route 25A, Kings Park, NY

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 authorizes the town of Smithtown, located in the county of
Suffolk, to discontinue 4,000 square feet of parklands, and alienate the
lands described in Section 3, and to transfer such lands to the county
of Suffolk to facilitate the placement and operation of a sewer pump
station at the Town of Smithtown Department of Parks, Building, and
Grounds located at 100 Route 25A, Kings Park, New York

Section 2 states that the authorization contained in section one of this
act shall take effect only upon the condition that the town of Smithtown
dedicate an amount equal to or greater than the fair market value of
parklands being discontinued towards the acquisition of new parklands
and/or towards capital improvements to existing parkland and recreation-
al facilities

Section 3 describes the legal description of the lands being trans-
ferred.

Section 4 states that if the lands described in Section 3, cease to be
used for the purposed described in Section 1, those lands shall revert
to the town of Smithtown for public park and recreational purposes. At
the time of such reversion, the removal of such sewer pump station shall
take place and the property shall be returned to its previous state,
consistent with park and recreational purposes

Section 5 conditions alienation upon the Town of Smithtown complying
with any federal requirements pertaining to alienation if the town
received any funding, support or assistance from the federal government
to purchase, maintain or improve parklands described in Section 3

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Town of Smithtown, in the County of Suffolk, unanimously adopted a
resolution requesting New York State to introduce legislation authoriz-
ing the Town to alienate 4,000 square feet of parkland via land transfer
to facilitate the placement and operation of a sewer pump station
located at the Parks, Buildings, & Grounds Department, 100 Route 25A,
Kings Park.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately

A.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S6973A

SPONSOR: FLANAGAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:  An act in relation to authorizing the town of Smith-
town, county of Suffolk, to alienate and convey certain parcels of land
used as parklands

 
PURPOSE:

To authorize the Town of Smithtown to alienate and convey 4,000 square
feet of land, used as parklands, and to transfer said parcel to the
County of Suffolk for the purpose of placing and operating a sewer pump
station at the Town of Smithtown Department of Parks, Buildings and
Grounds located at 100 Route 25A, Kings Park, NY

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 authorizes the town of Smithtown, located in the county of
Suffolk, to discontinue 4,000 square feet of parklands, and alienate the
lands described in section 3, and to transfer such lands to the county
of Suffolk to facilitate the placement and operation of a sewer pump
station at the Town of Smithtown Department of Parks, Buildings and
Grounds located at 100 Route 25A, Kings Park, New York.

Section 2 states that the authorization contained in section one of this
act shall take effect only upon the condition that the town of Smithtown
dedicate an amount equal to or greater than the fair market value of
parklands being discontinued towards the acquisition of new parklands
and/or towards capital improvements to existing parkland and recreation-
al facilities.

Section 3 describes the legal description of the lands being trans-
ferred.

Section 4 states that if the lands described in section 3, cease to be
used for the purpose described in section 1, those lands shall revert to
the town of Smithtown for public park and recreational purposes.  At the
time of such reversion, the removal of such sewer pump station shall
take place and the property shall be returned to its previous state,
consistent with park and recreational purposes.

Section 5 conditions alienation upon the Town of Smithtown complying
with any federal requirements pertaining to alienation if the town
received any funding, support or assistance from the federal government
to purchase, maintain or improve parklands described in Section 3.
Beginning at a point at the northeast corner of the herein described
parcel, said point being situate the following three (3) courses and
distances as measured from the monument found on the southerly side of
Main Street (NYS Route 25A) at the division line between land now or
formerly State of New York and land of the party of the first part:

(1) south 85 degrees 40 minutes 00 seconds west 11.90 feet as measured
along the southerly side of Main Street (NYS Route 25A);

(2) south 03 degrees 55 minutes 48 seconds east 194.45 feet as meas-
ured along land of the party of the first part;

(3) south 85 degrees 40 minutes 00 seconds west 171.02 feet as meas-
ured along land of the party of the first part.
Running thence from said point of beginning through land of the party of
the first part the following four courses of distances:

(1) south 04 degrees 20 minutes 00 seconds east 50 feet;

(2) south 85 degrees 40 minutes 00 seconds west 80 feet;

(3) north 04 degrees 20 minutes 00 seconds west 50 feet;

(4) north 85 degrees 40 minutes 00 seconds east 80 feet to the point or
place of beginning.

Total of 4,000 square feet.

Together with an access easement, bounded and described as follows:
Beginning at a point on the southerly side of Main street (NYS Route
25A), said point being situate south 85 degrees 40 minutes 00 seconds
west as measured along the southerly side of Main Street (NYS Route25A)
11.90 feet from the division line between land now or formerly State of
New York and land of the party of the first part;

Running thence from said point of beginning through land of the party of
the first part the following five (5) courses and distances:

(1) south 03 degrees 55 minutes 48 seconds east 194.45 feet;

(2) south 85 degrees 40 minutes 00 seconds west 251.02 feet;

(3) north 04 degrees 20 minutes 00 seconds west 24.00 feet;

(4) south 85 degrees 40 minutes 00 seconds east 221.19 feet;

(5) north 03 degrees 55 minutes 48 seconds west 170.45 feet to the
southerly side of Main Street (NYS Route 25A);

Running thence north 85 degrees 40 minutes 00 seconds east along the
southerly side of Main Street (NYS Route 25A) 30.00 feet to the point or
place of beginning. Total of 11,140 square footage or 0.26 acres of
parkland.

§ 4. Should the lands described in section three of this act cease to be
used for the purposes described in section one of this act, those lands
shall revert to the town of Smithtown for public park and recreational
purposes. At the time of such reversion, the county shall remove the
sewer pump station and the property shall be returned to its previous
state, consistent with park and recreational purposes.

§ 5. In the event that the town of Smithtown received any funding
support or assistance from the federal government for the purchase,
maintenance or improvement of the parklands set forth in section three
of this act, the discontinuance and alienation of such parkland author-
ized by the provisions of this act shall not occur until the town of
Smithtown has complied with any federal requirements pertaining to the
alienation or conversion of parkland, including satisfying the secretary
of the interior that the alienation or conversion complies with all
conditions which the secretary of the interior deems necessary to assure
the substitution of other lands shall be equivalent in fair market value
and usefulness to the lands being alienated or converted.
§ 6. This act shall take effect immediately.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Town of Smithtown, in the County of Suffolk, unanimously adopted a
Resolution requesting New York State to introduce legislation authoriz-
ing the Town to alienate 4,000 square feet of parkland via land transfer
to facilitate the placement and operation of a sewer pump station
located at the Parks, Building & Grounds Department, 100 Route 25A,
Kings Park.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.
